correctness.rationale: Gale evenness gives exactly k disjoint cycle edges per facet. For nonempty T, complement paths give matching rank sum floor(g_i/2); elementary compositions and parity choices give H(n,k,s) with n/s marked-vertex correction. Empty and simplex boundaries are explicitly proved. Fixed k Poisson limit follows from factorial moments; overlap and supercritical cases handled. Independent full facet enumeration and recursive matching oracle passed 295 plus 1368 finite checks; these checks are not treated as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The complete all-cardinality vertex-facet transversal polynomial and fixed-dimension Poisson erasure window are not implied by the established minimum size and minimum-layer classification. The 2026 motivating text treats high ratios via a different construction; the 2021 paper proves only the minimum for cyclic polytopes. Direct matched-object and alternative-terminology searches found no dominating full polynomial. Earlier bounded-matching vertex-subset enumerations remain a residual priority risk. The k=1 special case is ordinary cycle vertex-cover enumeration and is not presented as novel.
residual_risks: Unindexed or alternate-terminology counts of induced cycle vertex subsets with bounded maximum matching number could imply the polynomial.
The Poisson approximation for rare adjacent successes is classical, not claimed independently original.
Independent mathematical and literature review has not occurred.
The k=1 specialization is classical; novelty concerns the unified higher-dimensional full spectrum and its associated geometric threshold.

value.rationale: Full facet-transversal size distribution is a natural, previously undetermined geometric-hypergraph invariant. It yields exact probabilities for every Bernoulli retention rate and a sharp sqrt(n) window at fixed geometric dimension; this contrasts sharply with established near-half-size optimally selected transversals and is not just a recomputation of the minimum.
